Messages.Author: Lev Steshenko
Messages.Body: Can you use a wooden stake in combat if someone played immortal grapple?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Lev Steshenko wrote:
>
> Can you use a wooden stake in combat if someone played immortal grapple?

No. Only hand strikes are allowable. Wooden Stake is a melee
weapon. Therefore, a strike with it is a melee weapon strike, not
a hand strike.

--
